items.title: Deep-Dive Visit to Tech Leaders
items.desc: Step into TSMC and connect with local schools to get close to the front line of AI and semiconductors—an immersive day from industry to campus.

items.title: Cultural Crafts × Flavor Memories
items.desc: DIY at Guangxing Paper Mill, wheel-throwing in Yingge ceramics, and making Kuo Yuan Ye pineapple cakes—bringing century-old crafts and Taiwanese flavors home.

items.title: Mountains & Sea Ecology Panorama
items.desc: Sun Moon Lake boat cruise and cable car, Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village, Fangyuan intertidal oyster-cart experience, and Alishan forest trails—collect it all from lake gleam to sea of clouds.

items.title: Smooth & Worry-Free Logistics
items.desc: High-speed rail connections and private coach transfers, 5★/4★ hotels, and full-time chaperone with safety protocols—learning and travel with zero hassle.
